digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows - main branch health CI
problem_keywords: main ci reports red on cancellation
propositions: Cancelled runs on main render as red X in GitHub's commit list despite main being healthy, because concurrent runs with the same concurrency group cancel prior runs
Main branch CI must switch from push-triggered to schedule-triggered (every 6 hours, non-zero minutes: 41/47/53) to eliminate cancellations by construction
Non-main branch push CI and all pre-merge Gerrit verification gates remain unchanged; only mirror post-merge signal timing is altered
Scheduled/dispatched test.yml failure must emit a git bisect recipe with bad SHA, last-known-green SHA (resolved from Actions API run history), and the CI reproduction command
Last-known-green resolution requires actions: read scope and GH_TOKEN; must degrade gracefully to a visible placeholder if the API call fails, and never report a red main as green
All six affected workflows must gain or retain workflow_dispatch for on-demand health checks, and external-integration.yml stays weekly (once-a-day cap enforced)
